text:
Fern: Quick idea  hill sprint + crag skills clinic tomorrow evening? Meet 6:15pm at the riverside park steps for a 20min hill block, then a short bouldering clinic 7:00-8:00pm at the community crag. Low-key, bring water. :mountain:

Miles: Love it. Hills + technique sounds perfect. I can run drills for sprint mechanics. Will bring cones and a stopwatch. :stopwatch:

Kat: In for clinic only (will skip the sprints). Can lead footwork drills and short beta notes for common problems. :climbing_woman:

Noah: I can lend a couple of crash pads and a rope if we want to top-rope a line after the clinic. Shoe sizes: I have 8.5-10 for borrow.

Fern: React with :dash: for hill sprints, :climber: for clinic-only, :handshake: for both. Also react :headlamp: if you need a loaner light (it gets dark fast by the river).

Miles: :dash: :handshake:

Kat: :climber: (will bring tape and a brush)

Noah: :handshake: :headlamp:

wellness-bot: Note: City park permits required for groups >10. Automated: groups of 10+ should register with facilities 24h in advance. Also remember to pack out chalk waste.

Fern: Looks like a mixed crew. Plan: meet 6:15 at riverside steps, quick warm-up, hill sprint block (6:25-6:45), water break, move to crag by 6:50 for drills and optional top-rope from 7:15. Pads available for first-come. If you need shoes or pads DM Noah.

Miles: I'll post a 400m hill workout for beginners and a tougher variant. Also small reminder: short strides on the uphill, arms drive.

Kat: If anyone is new to climbing, I'll pair you with a buddy. No pressure, just skills and fun.

Noah: Bringing two small crash pads and one medium. DM sizes. I'll drop the rope at the office entrance at 5:45 for pickup if anyone needs it earlier.

Fern: Final check  who wants me to reserve a bench near the crag for gear? React :yes: or DM. Also there might be mosquitos  bring bug spray. :bug:
